M+ vs B2 MdAPE difference: -3.30 points, 95% CI [-5.01, -1.63] (paired cluster bootstrap over H3 res-7 cells).

80% interval coverage: 78.9% overall, median width 58.2% of value. Per city: Bangalore 70.6%, Chennai 78.9%, Hyderabad 83.4%, Mumbai 82.1%.

Routing operating point, unseen H3 cell: no threshold meets the rule (largest auto-accept share with MdAPE <= 10% and >20% over-valuation share <= 5% among accepted cases).
Routing operating point, seen locality: auto-accept when half-width <= 12%: 3.6% of cases, MdAPE 8.9%, over-valued >20% 3.2%.

API latency p95: 119 ms (13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13450HX (16 logical cores); Windows 11; Python 3.13.9; single uvicorn worker).
